title: RNA Modification Coverage Benchmarking Pipeline
description: Pipeline for benchmarking RNA modification detection tools across different coverage levels

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples.
input.help_text: You will need to create a samplesheet with information about the samples you would like to analyse before running the pipeline.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved.

genome_size.description: Size of genome/transcriptome for coverage calculation (e.g., '4.5m', '100k', '3g').
genome_size.help_text: This value is used to calculate target bases for each coverage level. Format: number followed by k/m/g suffix (e.g., '4.5m' for 4.5 megabases).

filtlong_options.title: Filtlong filtering options
filtlong_options.description: Options for configuring Filtlong read filtering.

coverage_levels.description: Comma-separated list of coverage levels to generate.
coverage_levels.help_text: Specify which coverage depths you want to generate filtered datasets for.

min_length.help_text: Reads shorter than this will be discarded.

length_weight.description: Weight for read length in Filtlong scoring.
length_weight.help_text: Higher values prioritize longer reads. Default of 10 strongly favors longer reads.

mean_q_weight.description: Weight for mean quality in Filtlong scoring.

window_q_weight.description: Weight for window quality in Filtlong scoring.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text: These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

max_job_request_options.title: Max job request options
max_job_request_options.description: Set the top limit for requested resources for any single job.
max_job_request_options.help_text: If you are running on a smaller system, a pipeline step requesting more resources than are available may cause the Nextflow to stop the run with an error.

max_cpus.description: Maximum number of CPUs that can be requested for any single job.
max_cpus.help_text: Use to set an upper-limit for the CPU requirement for each process.

max_memory.description: Maximum amount of memory that can be requested for any single job.
max_memory.help_text: Use to set an upper-limit for the memory requirement for each process.

max_time.description: Maximum amount of time that can be requested for any single job.
max_time.help_text: Use to set an upper-limit for the time requirement for each process.
